title: Interfaces and Type Aliases
description: Learn how to define custom types with interfaces and type aliases.

data.text: **Interfaces** and **type aliases** let you define custom types for objects. They're essential for describing the shape of data in your application.

data.title: Interface
Type Alias
Recommendation
data.text: Use interfaces for object shapes (especially public APIs). Use type aliases for unions, intersections, and utility types.

data.title: When to Choose
items: Use interfaces for object shapes and public APIs
Use type aliases for unions and intersections
Use interfaces when you need declaration merging
Use types for primitives and tuples

data.title: Exercise: Model a Blog Post
data.description: Define interfaces and types for a blog post system.
steps: Create a Post interface with id, title, content, and author
Create a RichPost type that extends Post with views and tags
Write a function that accepts RichPost and returns a summary
data.expectedOutcome: A well-typed blog post model using both interfaces and type aliases.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Type aliases can define any type
data.takeaway: Interfaces and types are essential for describing data shapes.
